items.title: Quantum Corridor, Ciena, and Toshiba Complete World’s First 1.6 Tb/s Quantum-Safe Optical Encryption Milestone on Live Commercial Network
items.summary: Trial combines high-speed optical encryption with post-quantum cryptography (PQC) algorithms and quantum key distribution (QKD) to ensure data confidentiality in the quantum era Quantum Corridor , Ciena (NYSE: CIEN) and Toshiba have completed a successful trial of high-speed quantum-safe networking on Quantum Corridor’s live commercial network in the Midwest United States.
